description: ViewModel for managing user settings in the crypto tracker mobile app.

classes.name: SettingsViewModel
classes.description: Handles the UI-related data for the settings screen using a Flow for state management.

classes.name: SettingsUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the different states of the settings UI, including loading, success, and error states.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads user settings when the ViewModel is initialized, updating the UI state based on user authentication.

methods.name: updatePriceAlerts
methods.description: Updates the price alert setting and handles any errors during the process.

methods.name: updateNewsAlerts
methods.description: Updates the news alert setting and handles any errors during the process.

methods.name: updateCurrency
methods.description: Updates the selected currency and handles any errors during the process.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the user and updates the UI state to reflect the sign-out process.

methods.name: updateUiState
methods.description: Updates the current UI state with new values based on the previous state.
